# AgrowNex

> AgrowNex is a full-stack agritech company from Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, India. It runs a Tamil-first AI farming app and serves farmers and FPOs across seven engines: farm inputs, AI advisory, produce trading and export, finance through regulated partners, own brands and value-add, export support for FPOs, and programmes (training, equipment rental, organic certification). Operated by SANTA MARIA ENTERPRISES (Udyam-registered MSME, UDYAM-TN-26-0095328). Website: https://agrownex.com

## What AgrowNex does
- AI crop disease detection from a leaf photo, with organic care first and a chemical option only if needed. When unsure, it says so and suggests an expert.
- Official mandi (market) prices from the Government of India's Agmarknet / data.gov.in. Prices are never estimated.
- Village-level weather and spray/irrigation advice (Open-Meteo).
- Crop calendar and daily farm tasks for 15 crops, based on TNAU and ICAR guidance.
- AI help in Tamil by voice or text; government scheme finder; soil health card and Sentinel-2 satellite crop view; growth and nutrient checks.
- Sell-your-produce listings, and direct sourcing for wholesale buyers (processors, rice mills, spice companies, exporters, traders).
- Partner tools for FPOs and KVKs: consent-based member join requests, member and crop lists, harvest calendar, member needs, CSV export and a data feed.

## Key facts
- Category: agritech, AI in agriculture, farming app, FPO software
- Region: Tamil Nadu, India (Thoothukudi, Tirunelveli, Kanyakumari, Ramanathapuram and beyond)
- Languages: Tamil and English
- Platform: Android app (Google Play launch coming soon); free for farmers, no ads
- Crops: paddy, banana, chilli, cotton, groundnut, coconut, pulses, vegetables and more
- Field presence: presented to farmers at the Agricultural Science Centre (KVK), Thirupathisaram, Kanyakumari
- Contact: agrowai.tn@gmail.com · WhatsApp +91 86672 37404 · 232/1 North Raja Street, Thoothukudi 628001
